title: LiteLLM v1.106.8 fixes transcription cost for some FLAC files
points: Transcription cost is correct for some FLAC files that could push a key over its budget.
Per-second transcriptions bill the `usage.seconds` that the provider reports, so spend matches the provider invoice and unmeasured files no longer log $0.

title: LiteLLM v1.104.9 and v1.103.11 speed up request lookups in the Logs view
points: After migrations, the proxy builds the spend log indexes that some installs lack, so request lookups in the Logs view stay fast on large tables.
On v1.103.11, replicas that boot together against one database start up more reliably while a peer runs or recovers migrations.

title: LiteLLM v1.109.0 adds 11 providers, Codex tool search and daily limits
points: LiteLLM adds 11 providers, including ai&, StreamLake, OpenInfer and BigModel, among 311 new model catalog entries.
Codex discovers MCP tools through tool search, and deployments accept `rpd` and `tpd` daily limits.
Streams that stall, abort or end without a finish reason now fail visibly, so retries, cooldowns and fallbacks apply to them.
Claude models missing from the cost map now default to `max_tokens: 128000`, and `DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS=4096` keeps the old value.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.5 (LTS) fixes workload identity on OpenAI routes and transcription cost
points: Keyless workload identity OpenAI deployments no longer answer 401 on image edits, audio, files, batches and the other routes beyond chat.
Transcription cost is correct for some FLAC files that could push a key over its budget.
`ollama_chat/` streams give each parallel tool call its own index, and `/v1/messages` honors a deployment's `additional_drop_params`.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.4 (LTS) fixes Bedrock pass-through guardrails and video polls
points: The `/bedrock` pass-through routes enforce the model's `guardrailConfig`, and it replaces any guardrail the caller sends.
Video status and content polls keep their model, so per-model keys work and each poll reaches the account that created the video.
A base SDK install no longer fails with `No module named 'mcp'` when `completion()`, `responses()` or `messages` get a tool.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.3 (LTS) fixes Bedrock api_base and large MCP tool results
points: Bedrock deployments with `api_base: ""` serve requests again, and no longer return 500 or 400.
MCP tool results over 1 MiB no longer fail with `SSE stream ended without a response`, and model-level `post_call` guardrails check each response once.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.2 (LTS) fixes Bedrock service tiers and Claude PDF input
points: Bedrock Converse honors the `reserved`, `auto` and `standard_only` service tiers and returns 400 for a tier that it does not support.
Base64 PDFs that you send to Claude as `image_url` work, and `openai/` deployments with an empty `api_key` no longer send `OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY`.
Groups that accept unmatched tags keep the request after affinity or cooldown filters.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.1 (LTS) fixes Bedrock guardrail billing and router cooldowns
points: A string fallback target such as `default_fallbacks: gpt-3.5` stops the proxy at startup, so write it as a list, `default_fallbacks: ["gpt-3.5"]`.
Spend and budgets include native Bedrock guardrail traces and the Gemini audio rates for flex, priority and batch.
The router keeps the only deployment of a group warm under `allowed_fails`, and evicted SDK clients close their aiohttp sessions.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.7 supports custom video providers on /v1/videos
points: `/v1/videos` serves providers that `custom_provider_map` registers.
The proxy and its Helm charts no longer package the Lens beta, so remove `lensWorker.enabled` from your Helm values before you upgrade.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.0 (LTS) adds Gemini 4 Argon, Microsoft 365 Copilot and OpenAI Live
points: LiteLLM adds Gemini 4 Argon, the Microsoft 365 Copilot provider, OpenAI Live sessions on `/v1/live/sessions` and Azure PTU capacity that teams share.
The proxy count routes return the provider's error instead of a local estimate, and `token_count_framing` in `model_info` restores a local estimate.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.6 and v1.105.7 fix the gzip performance regression
points: The proxy gzips only dashboard analytics responses and compresses them on a worker thread, so `Accept-Encoding: gzip` no longer slows down other requests.
Inference and other endpoints outside the dashboard analytics routes return uncompressed responses, and no setting restores the old gzip behavior.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.5, v1.105.6, v1.104.8 and v1.103.10 trim failure logs for rejected requests
points: Failure logs for rejected requests keep only core request fields, `tags` and guardrail details.
The GCS logger uses the bucket and credentials configured on the proxy.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.4, v1.105.5, v1.104.7 and v1.103.9 refresh image base layers
points: Docker images move to newer base images, so image scans stop flagging brotli 1.2.0 and packages the images never install.
v1.106.4, v1.105.5 and v1.104.7 no longer sometimes exit on startup with an `ImportError` when the remote model cost map is unreachable.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.3, v1.105.4, v1.104.6 and v1.103.8 change the image-signing key
points: Docker images and Helm charts are signed with the cosign key from commit `e82a3c6`, and the previous key no longer verifies them.
Every certificate bundle the SDK, proxy and images trust drops the eMudhra root CA.
v1.104.6 also fixes spend on failed and batch requests, token counts and tool calls on gpt-5.4+ models.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.2, v1.105.3 and v1.103.7 fix spend on failed requests and batch cost
points: Requests that time out after reaching the provider, client cancellations and each billed retry attempt are priced on their prompt instead of logging $0.
Completed batches keep their spend through malformed results and temporary accounting failures, and Bedrock inference profiles are priced.
Azure `gpt-6-astra` with `reasoning_effort: none` and `gpt-5.3-codex` with `minimal` now return 400 unless `drop_params` is on.
v1.105.3 also lists per-user auth MCP tools in the catalog again.

title: LiteLLM v1.104.5 counts Claude tokens on Bedrock Mantle when Bedrock Runtime cannot
points: Token counts for newer Claude models on Bedrock come from the Bedrock Mantle endpoint instead of a local estimate that undercounts.

title: LiteLLM v1.104.4 fixes count_tokens, team batch access and guardrail settings
points: Anthropic-format count requests for OpenAI and Gemini models are converted the same way `/v1/messages` inference converts them.
Team keys can read and cancel their own team's batches and download the finished results.
The Add Guardrail wizard in the Admin UI lists its providers again.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.1 fixes count_tokens, MCP tool calls and thinking blocks
points: Bare MCP tool names on a single-server scope now go to that server, so a cold replica no longer returns `Tool not found`.
Vector stores created through the proxy send only the caller's `metadata` to the provider, so later metadata updates no longer fail with 400.
Token count responses carry `litellm_count_source`, and Anthropic-format count requests for OpenAI and Gemini models match how `/v1/messages` converts them.

title: LiteLLM v1.105.2 fixes count_tokens, bridged tool calls and thinking blocks
points: Chat completions bridged to `/responses` return text and tool calls in one `choices[0]`, so agents that read only `choices[0]` run the tool.
Signed thinking blocks with empty text stay on `/v1/messages` and chat completion requests, so replayed turns keep their reasoning.
The `v1.104.4` token count fixes are included, and count responses carry `litellm_count_source`.

title: LiteLLM v1.103.6 fixes realtime handshake errors and double spend logs
points: A refused upstream realtime handshake now sends the client an `error` event and closes with 1008, 1013 or 1011.
Non-streaming requests of 256 KiB or more on the chat to Responses bridge now log spend once instead of twice.
This patch has no new database migrations.
